H4600.def: to press, i.e. to pierce, emasculate, handle

H4601.def: Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman
H4601.kjv: Maachah, Maachathites. See also H1038 (בֵּית מַעֲכָה).

H4602.def: a Maakathite, or inhabitant of Maakah

H4603.def: properly, to cover up; used only figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. treacherously

H4604.kjv: falsehood, grievously, sore, transgression, trespass, [idiom] very.

H4605.def: properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.
H4605.kjv: above, exceeding(-ly), forward, on ([idiom] very) high, over, up(-on, -ward), very.

H4606.def: (only in plural as singular) the setting (of the sun)

H4608.def: an elevation, i.e. (concretely) acclivity or platform; abstractly (the relation or state) a rise or (figuratively) priority
H4608.kjv: ascent, before, chiefest, cliff, that goeth up, going up, hill, mounting up, stairs.

H4609.def: elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grademark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms)
H4609.kjv: things that come up, (high) degree, deal, go up, stair, step, story.

H4610.derivation: from H4608 (מַעֲלֶה) and (the plural of) H6137 (עַקְרָב);
H4610.def: Steep of Scorpions, a place in the Desert
H4610.kjv: Maaleh-accrabim, the ascent (going up) of Akrabbim.

H4616.def: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H4616.kjv: because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,... 's sake), [phrase] lest, that, to.

H4618.derivation: from H6031 (עָנָה), in the sense of depression or tilling;

H4621.derivation: from an unused root meaning to hew;

H4624.derivation: from an unused root meaning to repress;

H4626.def: a nude place, i.e. (literally) the pudenda, or (figuratively) a vacant space

H4627.derivation: from H6148 (עָרַב), in the sense of trading;

H4628.derivation: or (feminine) מַעֲרָבָה; from H6150 (עָרַב), in the sense of shading;
H4628.def: the west (as a region of the evening sun)

H4629.def: a nude place, i.e. a common

H4634.def: an arrangement; concretely, a pile; specifically a military array
H4634.kjv: army, fight, be set in order, ordered place, rank, row.

H4635.def: an arrangement, i.e. (concretely) a pile (of loaves)

H4636.derivation: from H6191 (עָרַם), in the sense of stripping;

H4639.def: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H4639.kjv: act, art, [phrase] bakemeat, business, deed, do(-ing), labor, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, [idiom] well, (handy-, needle-, net-) work(ing, -manship), wrought.

H4641.derivation: or מַעֲשֵׂיָהוּ; from H4639 (מַעֲשֶׂה) and H3050 (יָהּ); work of Jah;
H4641.def: Maasejah, the name of sixteen Israelites

H4643.derivation: or מַעֲשַׂר; and (in plural) feminine מַעַשְׂרָה; from H6240 (עָשָׂר);

H4644.def: Moph, the capital of Lower Egypt

H4646.def: a breathing out (of life), i.e. expiring

H4648.derivation: or מְפִבֹשֶׁת; probably from H6284 (פָּאָה) and H1322 (בֹּשֶׁת); dispeller of shame (i.e. of Baal);
H4648.def: Mephibosheth, the name of two Israelites

H4649.derivation: a plural apparently from H5130 (נוּף); wavings;

H4651.def: a falling off, i.e. chaff; also something pendulous, i.e. a flap

H4657.derivation: from an unused root meaning to balance;

H4658.def: fall, i.e. decadence; concretely, a ruin; specifically a carcase

H4661.def: a smiter, i.e. a war club

H4662.def: an appointment, i.e. mandate; concretely, a designated spot; specifically, a census

H4663.def: Miphkad, the name of a gate in Jerusalem

H4664.derivation: from H6555 (פָּרַץ)lemma פּרַץ missing vowel, corrected to פָּרַץ;
H4664.def: a break (in the shore), i.e. a haven

H4665.def: properly, a fracture, i.e. joint (vertebrae) of the neck

H4667.def: a stride, i.e. (by euphemism) the crotch

H4671.def: chaff (as pressed out, i.e. winnowed or (rather) threshed loose)

H4672.def: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H4672.kjv: [phrase] be able, befall, being, catch, [idiom] certainly, (cause to) come (on, to, to hand), deliver, be enough (cause to) find(-ing, occasion, out), get (hold upon), [idiom] have (here), be here, hit, be left, light (up-) on, meet (with), [idiom] occasion serve, (be) present, ready, speed, suffice, take hold on.

H4673.def: a fixed spot; figuratively, an office, a military post

H4676.def: something stationed, i.e. a column or (memorial stone); by analogy, an idol

H4677.derivation: apparently from H4672 (מָצָא) and H3050 (יָהּ); found of Jah;

H4678.def: something stationary, i.e. a monumental stone; also the stock of atree

H4679.derivation: or מְצָד; or (feminine) מְצָדָה; from H6679 (צוּד);
H4679.def: a fastness (as a covert of ambush)

H4680.def: to suck out; by implication, to drain, to squeeze out

H4681.derivation: active participle feminine of H4680 (מָצָה); drained;

H4682.derivation: from H4711 (מָצַץ) in the sense of greedily devouring for sweetness;
H4682.def: properly, sweetness; concretely, sweet (i.e. not soured or bittered with yeast); specifically, an unfermented cake or loaf, or (elliptically) the festival of Passover (because no leaven was then used)

H4684.def: a whinnying (through impatience for battle or lust)

H4685.derivation: or (feminine) מְצוֹדָה; or מצֹדָה; from H6679 (צוּד); also (by interchange for H4679 (מְצַד))
H4685.def: a net (for capturing animals or fishes); afastness or (beseiging) tower

H4686.derivation: or (feminine) מְצוּדָה; or מְצֻדָה; for H4685 (מָצוֹד);
H4686.def: a net, or (abstractly) capture; also a fastness
H4686.kjv: castle, defense, fort(-ress), (strong) hold, be hunted, net, snare, strong place.

H4687.def: a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law)

H4688.derivation: or מְצֹלָה; also מְצוּלָה; or מְצֻלָה; from the same as H6683 (צוּלָה);
H4688.def: a deep place (of water or mud)

H4689.def: a narrow place, i.e. (abstractly and figuratively) confinement or disability

H4690.def: something narrow, i.e. a column or hilltop

H4692.def: something hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of besiegers), (abstractly) a siege, (figuratively) distress; or (subjectively) a fastness
H4692.kjv: besieged, bulwark, defence, fenced, fortress, siege, strong (hold), tower.

H4693.derivation: the same as H4692 (מָצוֹר) in the sense of a limit;

H4694.def: a hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of siege), or (subjectively) a rampart (of protection), (abstractly) fortification

H4696.derivation: from an unused root meaning to be clear, i.e. conspicuous;

H4697.def: a shinpiece of armor (as prominent), only plural
